main_text.head: Nobilissimo atque Amplissimo Viro,
DOMINO Ioanni ab Oldenbarnevelt, Illustrium DD. Ordinum HOLLANDIAE & WVESTFRISIAE Aduocato & a consiliis prudentissimo,
main_text.p: FRANCISCVS IVNIVS S. T. a Domino.

SI quantum natura duce, Vir nobilissime atque amplissime, perpetua serie experientiæ, & constantibus sapientum omnium iudiciis docentur boni τὰ ἴδια φράτσειν (ut Apostolus præcipit) & τὰ ἀλλόξια μὴ πολυπραγμονεῖν, tantum id bonis semper obseruare per alios licuisset; equidem non fuissem in hoc tempore appellaturus T. A. & grauissimas occupationes tuas interpellaturus inscriptio-

page.notes: The first word of the body is a historiated initial "S" joined to "I quantum": transcribed as printed reading "SI quantum". Greek text partly uncertain: "τὰ ἴδια" and "ἀλλόξια" read from the scan; "μὴ πολυπραγμονεῖν" read with uncertainty. Line "FRANCISCVS IVNIVS S. T. a Domino." is the sender's line, set as a paragraph. Marginal text on the left and right belongs to a verso or adjacent page and is not transcribed as notes; faint show-through text is omitted.
